lines.text: The Span is not perfect. Good. Nothing behind it was the danger. Now there is something behind it.
There is a book. Locked. Names of everyone we mended for. I have never shown it.

choice.text: Write the apprentices' names in it. They belong there.
Keep it locked. A bridge does not need to be thanked.

lines.text: ...Ilsa. Pel. Even Oda. I will add them. Do not tell anyone.
You are my student. I am proud. I will not say it twice.
